packageRules.description: Python: patch PR (3.13.8 → 3.13.17: automerged, automatic release) kept apart from the minor PR (→ 3.15: by hand); without this Renovate only offers the newest minor

Python base image patch updates (3.13.8 → 3.13.9) and digest updates (same tag rebuilt with Alpine fixes): Renovate merges once CI (unit + container tests) is green; the merge makes an automatic patch release
Python minor/major (3.13 → 3.14, a new language version): PR only, merged by hand after a look
GitHub Actions minor/patch: merged once CI is green, no release (the image doesn't change); major by hand
cdnjs libraries in site/index.html (Chart.js) minor/patch: merged once CI is green; the merge makes an automatic patch release (auto-release.sh)
Trivy (CI self-scan only, not in the image): minor/patch merged after tests, no release
